about: V3-1 (b) semantic cost of predicting column when the truth is row. Pair = (A older, B newer); directed relations read 'B <relation> A'. EDITABLE BY TRAVIS UNTIL THE FIRST RUN; score.py records the sha256 of the matrix it used. 'given' cells come from the T4 draft relayed 2026-09-28; 'filled' cells are Claude's completion of the same rule and are the ones most worth checking.
invariant: Graphonomous should prefer missing a relation over asserting a materially wrong relation.

given: abstain when a relation exists: 1 (every row's abstain)
unrelated / scope_disjoint predicted when a meaningful relation exists: 2
duplicate asserted over distinct claims: 5 (every non-duplicate row's duplicate column)
refines asserted where the newer claim materially changes or rejects the older (supersedes, contradicts, evidence_against rows): 5
true supersedes -> abstain 1, -> unrelated 2; true contradicts -> abstain 1
filled: duplicate -> refines: 3 (weak: both say the claims agree)
supersedes -> contradicts: 2 (under-asserts: flags an unresolved conflict instead of a replacement; triggers review, corrupts nothing)
supersedes -> evidence_against: 3 and contradicts -> evidence_against: 3 (weaker claim of the same polarity)
evidence_against -> contradicts: 7 (negative evidence is not contradiction: counted as a false contradicts)
refines asserted over unrelated / scope_disjoint pairs: 5 (a false relation, priced like a false duplicate)
unrelated <-> scope_disjoint: 1 (neither mutates meaning; a review-sized error)
abstain when the truth is unrelated or scope_disjoint: 1 (the review cost is the same whatever the truth)
